answer: Require every new identity to lock a small, non-refundable stake in a shared grove of collateral, released only after independent peers attest its work. An operator spinning up thousands of fake accounts must fund each one up front, so the cost of a Sybil swarm scales linearly with its size. Like a river that only reaches its zenith when many real tributaries converge, trust here grows only from many independent attestations, and one attacker cannot fake that convergence without paying for every identity.
